# PopulationChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasPopulationChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasPopulationChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasPopulationChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasPopulationChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Values either side of a centre: likert scales, demographics

## Overview

Population pyramid chart class - inherits from UltraCanvasUIElement

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasPopulationChart(const std::string& identifier = "PopulationChart", int x = 0, int y = 0, int w = 600, int h = 700);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
